<!-- pr-reviewer: 65ec94c5c2a846015eb05a0296924a4e2c121f8a -->
**Verdict:** Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is the second review round of this PR. The first review of head `bea85a429` requested three items (UI evidence, the process declaration, and a legacy-project post test). The new head `65ec94c5c` answers all three: the body carries a "Screenshots" section with the five before/after pairs of #4022, it carries the exact `Process change: yes` line and does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, and the new `agie_native::legacy_name` test posts a project saved under each old name, compares the job files with the unchanged goldens, and checks the save writes the new name. I re-reviewed the full diff since `bea85a429` — the #4022 parent merges, the hand-resolved merge in `crates/app/tests/agie_native.rs`, the legacy-name test, and the `model_arcs` fixture fix — not just the two new commits.

## What looks good

- The new opening writer (`crates/post/src/agie/opening.rs`, `opening/walls.rs`) keeps the exact-grid model and the named refusals the control's own rules need (offsets, joints, spacing, hole and entry, stock), with every refusal naming its rule and its values. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`; all new modules carry a provenance line; all files stay under 400 lines.
- The shared inspected-chain glue moved to `crates/app/src/operation/agie_opening.rs` without changing the inspection export behaviour; the die dispatch in `posting_agie.rs` uses the shared `AgieSketch` enum with the punch side unchanged.
- The rename is one table (`posting_aliases.rs`) with the old names as hidden aliases everywhere (commands, machine validation, project apply, mount dto, UI, MCP skill, examples, goldens' error text). The `wire_post_alias` hygiene test asserts no source text names the post "native wire EDM" or "native controller".
- The example (`examples/agie/reentrant-die.camscript` + `.dxf`) and the golden `REENT20.ISO` are a real, controlled evidence, and `docs/decisions/3178-agie-reentrant-opening.md` records the rules, the control evidence (REENT20 unmodified, FILR/RADA/RADB hand edits) and what was dropped.

## Results merged with main

Local build and tests (fork PR — no runner). Trial merge of this head with current `origin/main` (`a5b8734a6`) is clean; the auto-merge took main's `PROCESS_VERSION` 155, the #4039 guide-reach check in `agie_profile.rs` and the other main-side merges. All builds ran with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6` and `-j 6` (`RUSTC_WRAPPER=`, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`).

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` lib, `agie::` (all) | 67 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-post` lib, `agie::opening_tests` (9) | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-post` `comment_escape` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test agie_native` (incl. `legacy_name`, `opening`) | 40 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_dxf_selection` (incl. `arcs`) | 15 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_post_alias` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test mcp_wire_contour` | 10 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test plasma_post_refusals` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_post model_arcs` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib | 1688 passed, 0 failed (8 ignored) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No failure text anywhere; no suite was skipped.

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: no catalog suite covers Agie examples (the catalog suites cover 2D/3D milling and turning). Coverage for this PR is the `agie_native` binary and the post lib.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`): 6 steps, 0 failed, wall 1.2 min (the motion and one app pocket twin). Red steps would be a note, not a blocker.
- P6: no targeted heavy step. (The earlier round ran the light lane and post lib tests; this round re-ran them plus the touched app and UI suites and strict clippy.)

## Requested before merge

None blocking.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `inside()` in `crates/post/src/agie/opening.rs` documents and errors "The complete 2 mm start hole must lie inside the die opening, more than 1 mm from every wall". The check is the hole center more than 1 mm from every wall; the complete-hole guarantee comes from the app-side `clearance.contains_disk(center, 1.0 + 1e-8)` (`agie_profile.rs`). The text overstates the check — a one-line fix of the doc/error wording would close the gap.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` still describes only the convex die opening (picked edge chains through `set_operation_geometry`); the new reentrant DXF line-and-arc die opening of #3178 is not documented there. A follow-up docs PR (or one line in this PR's body) would close the gap.
3. Stacked on #4022: the body says "Retarget this PR to `main` before #4022 merges". When #4022 merges, the maintainer should confirm the retarget so the GitHub UI shows the real base.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: adc75396819246b181aaac1f0e53a595d772a529 -->
**Verdict:** Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is the third review round of this PR. The head since the last counted review is `adc753968192` — a single merge of the #4022 branch's new head (`ca5f06173`, "Merge main into issue/4000-agie-wire-edm-name (keep both sides)"). The own commit `bea85a429` and every own file are byte-identical to the reviewed head `65ec94c5c`: the merge only brought in main's commits (de035b4c3, a5b8734a6, etc.) and main's version of one own-file test, `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs`, which took the #1865 expanded-INSERT change. I reviewed the delta (`git diff 65ec94c5c..adc753968192`), the full three-dot diff vs `origin/main`, the trial merge with the current `origin/main` (`12ea01a45`), the #4022 parent body and its screenshot folder, and ran the touched suites and strict clippy on the merged tree.

## What looks good

- The merge is clean and content-preserving: the own files (`crates/post/src/agie/opening.rs`, `opening/walls.rs`, `opening_tests.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/agie_opening.rs`, `crates/app/tests/agie_native/opening.rs`, `REENT20.ISO`, the reentrant example) are byte-identical to the reviewed head. The only change in the delta that touches the PR's own scope is main's #4039 guide-reach check in `agie_profile.rs` and main's #1865 expanded-INSERT test in `arcs.rs` — both main's content, not the PR's.
- The delta brings no #4022-branch commits that are not #4022's three feature commits and their merges of main: `git rev-list origin/main..ca5f06173` is exactly `ca5f06173`, `87805dcf9`, `e212b0b87`, `1b080d420`, `028530986`, `f6f40a28a`.
- The PR carries the exact `Process change: yes` line, and its diff vs `origin/main` touches no protected path (no `.github/`, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.cargo/`, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, `rust-toolchain`, `xtask/`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`). The process file `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is an add-listing of the rename — the declaration matches the delta.
- The UI evidence section matches the parent #4022 exactly: the same five before/after pairs with the same raw URLs (`before|after` post list, post dialog scope line, post dialog per-op refusal, status line, wire page hint). All ten images return HTTP 200 with real byte counts (before 67821–205667, after 69588–211104 bytes). No new UI change is claimed or made — the own commit touches no `crates/ui` file.
- No posted-G-code drift beyond the intent: the only golden changes are the new `REENT20.ISO` (the reentrant opening, explained by the PR body and `docs/decisions/3178-agie-reentrant-opening.md`) and the 11 `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/agie-native/*.refusal` files, each changing exactly one line (the post-name refusal text). The `arcs` tests updated by main's #1865 change pass.
- All new modules carry a provenance line; files stay under 400 lines; no `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` outside tests in the new code; the examples and the user guide stay in place.

## Results merged with main

Local build and tests (fork PR — no runner; the local worktree trial-merge of this head with `origin/main` (`12ea01a45`) is clean, no conflicts). All builds ran with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6` and `-j 6`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4040-review` (the worktree's own `target/`).

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` lib (all) | 161 passed, 0 failed (`agie::opening_tests` 9/9) |
| `camcraft-post` `script_agie_native` | 11 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test agie_native` (incl. `opening`, `legacy_name`) | 40 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_post_alias` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_dxf_selection` (incl. `arcs`, incl. the main-side #1865 INSERT test) | 16 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test mcp_wire_contour` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test plasma_post_refusals` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib, `agie_post` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 (the `--all-targets` check runs on the trial-merged tree; the merged tree builds) |

No failure text anywhere; no suite was skipped.

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: no catalog suite covers Agie examples (the catalog suites cover 2D/3D milling and turning). Coverage for this PR is `agie_native` and the post lib.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, 6 steps, in release): **not run on this head.** The parent round ran it green at `65ec94c5c` (6 steps, 0 failed); the delta since then is main merges only, and the PR is P6, so no heavy step is required. The light lane is not a merge condition and it is not run here under the 40-minute budget with CPU contention from another worktree's build.
- P6: no targeted heavy step. (The feature posts through the Agie post; the wire laws and the golden ISO pin the output, and the own pinning tests are in `agie::opening_tests` and `camcraft-app --test agie_native`.)
- Stale-head honesty: the gate section in the body reports results only for `65ec94c5c` (main `aef12fea6` + #4022 head `87805dcf9` merged in). This round's results above are the current merged head (`12ea01a45` + #4022 head `ca5f06173`).

## Requested before merge

None blocking.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The PR is stacked on #4022. The body says "Retarget this PR to `main` before #4022 merges" — when #4022 merges, confirm the retarget so the GitHub UI shows the real base.
2. The two non-blocking notes of the previous round still stand: `inside()` in `crates/post/src/agie/opening.rs` documents a complete-2 mm-hole guarantee that the hole-centre check does not fully back, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` does not document the new reentrant line-and-arc die opening. A one-line follow-up would close both.
3. The `conflicts` label on the PR is stale (the trial merge with `origin/main` `12ea01a45` is clean and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`); this review removes it in favour of `merge-ready`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
